sample_unit: paired multimodal samples (2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans, CT-derived skeletal models)
unlisted_practices: Using CT-free AI reconstruction from mobile 2D facial photographs for remote triage and radiation-free follow-up, complementing rather than replacing CT-based definitive diagnosis

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI framework (Tele-Cranio) that reconstructs 3D facial/skeletal morphology and simulates postoperative results from 2D photos to support telemedicine assessment, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
